_comment: Curated meta-tech OVERLAY merged into the vendored ps_sets_gen9.json by
ps_sets.PSSetsIndex. Same schema as PS's sets export ({format: {dex|stats:
{Species: {SetName: set}}}}); a set name that collides with a vendored set
REPLACES it, a new name ADDS a candidate.
WHY THIS EXISTS: PS's export flattens Smogon's slashed move options to the
FIRST option only (verified 2026-07-30: 0 of 278 gen9ou sets carry any
alternative), so every slashed tech move is invisible to world-0 set
sampling. First casualty found live: Kingambit's 'Iron Head / Low Kick'
slash — our worlds never saw Low Kick, so switching our own Kingambit into
theirs read as safe when Low Kick is actually a 4x, 120-BP punish that
STRICTLY DOMINATES Iron Head in the mirror (ties it vs most stay-ins).
A move slot may be a LIST of alternatives (restoring the Smogon slash) —
ps_sets.py expands each combination into its own candidate with the set's
sampling weight split evenly, so `consistent()` filtering on revealed
moves keeps exactly the variants the observations allow.
Keep entries FEW and justified: this is for tech that changes decisions
(coverage that punishes the standard answer), not for exhaustive set
listing — the chaos tier already carries usage marginals.
